corpus: One recorded OSR speaker in two excerpts; one macOS synthesized male voice
cases: 21 controlled noisy 300-2700 Hz cases; three clean cases. No off-air recordings.
memory_before: Exact array-allocation test: 3044838 bytes leaked after one denoiser destruction; twenty resets grew RSS about 61 MB.
memory_after: 32 resets return outstanding array bytes to baseline; 20-reset RSS growth is allocator high-water retention, about 3.2 MB.
audio_nr2_ownership_fix: Output byte-identical on retained clean speech input before/after cleanup; no suppression parameter changes.
limitations: eSTOI/STOI and SI-SDR are proxies, not live listening acceptance
Core ML probe uses older ORT Python runtime; native shipped inference uses CPU provider and Apple FFT
Unpaced File-source whole-process CPU cannot establish real-time savings
Linked ONNX Runtime and VOLK libraries are not ASAN instrumented
